sign_convention: trajectory ordered by time_window_min DESCENDING (farthest-from-onset first); positive tau / Sen's slope == AUROC rises toward onset == clinical faithfulness
bootstrap_resample_unit: highest identifiable unit: patient (subject_id) for EPIC/VitalDB, surgical case (case_id) for MOVER/SIS
fixed_horizon_definition: among event cases with observed_min >= X, the share whose earliest crossing was at least X minutes before onset; numerator and denominator move together
censoring: administrative, at each case's own observed_min; NOT independent of the event, because for an event case a short observable run-up is an early-onset event rather than missing data
